## Copilot Code Review Instructions

- **Do not suppress comments.** Always raise every issue you find, regardless of severity. Do not omit or combine comments to reduce noise.
- **Re-review behavior:** When re-reviewing a PR where you have previously left comments, check whether those issues have been addressed. For each resolved issue, leave a brief closing comment acknowledging the fix (e.g. "✅ This has been addressed."). Do not re-raise issues that have been fixed.
- **Merge readiness verdict:** At the end of every review, explicitly state whether the PR is **"Ready to merge"** or **"Not ready to merge"**, with a one-line summary of the reason.
